backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing user balances, inventories, and 50 cosmetic items with purchase logic, admin fund grants (code 2807), and periodic income distribution.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to debugging image loading, verifying image file existence, and ensuring correct slug mapping for 50 cosmetic items.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of 10 frontend files describing the shop interface, hooks, components, and styling with corrected image mapping for 50 backend items to 15 available images.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color palette variables for light and dark modes, using warm coral, peach, and rose gold tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Virtual Cosmetics Shop application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with tab navigation between Shop and Owned Items views, user initialization on mount, header with tab buttons, and footer with admin box and attribution.
frontend/src/components/AdminBox.tsx: Discreet admin code input form with 30% opacity (100% on hover) that accepts numeric codes to grant funds via useAdminGrantFunds hook.
frontend/src/components/BalanceDisplay.t: Card component displaying user's balance with currency icon, formatted number, gradient styling, and glow effect.
frontend/src/components/CosmeticItem.tsx: Cosmetic item card with getImageSlug function mapping all 50 backend item names to 15 available images, displays product details, price badge, image with fallback, and purchase button or ownership indicator.
frontend/src/components/OwnedItemsView.t: Displays a user's owned cosmetic items in a grid layout with images, using a mapping function to match item names to available asset slugs. Handles loading states, errors, and shows item details including rarity badges.
frontend/src/components/PurchaseButton.t: A button component for purchasing items that shows loading state during purchase and disables itself when user cannot afford the item or during processing.
frontend/src/components/ShopInterface.ts: Main shop view that displays user balance and a grid of all available cosmetic items, filtering to show ownership status and handling loading/error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing auth client creation and identity persistence with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including balance, items, purchases, and admin functions, with toast notifications for user feedback.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using OKLCH color space, defining light and dark mode themes with warm coral/peach tones and rose gold accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom colors using OKLCH, border radius variables, glow shadows, accordion animations, and typography/container plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting a virtual shopping app with Gorilla Tag cosmetics, £100 starting balance, automatic income, and admin features. Currently has known issues with cosmetic items not loading, mod panel not appearing, and image loading failures.
